source_snapshot.procedure: Get with 04h/2Fh over IB and OOB; Set with 04h/2Eh over IB and OOB; Get again over both paths. Generic pre/post boilerplate proposes clearing logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All commands have no error and the sensor type is set correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES, but replaces the selected raw transaction with insecure sshpass/disabled-host-key generic sensor info and leaves judgment to the user.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because the Get title conflicts with the Set-then-Get procedure/criterion and the separate Set row.

old_problem: The historical review required an owner to choose Get-only versus Set-then-Get before any safe case could exist. Direct source inspection shows that the complete procedure and write-oriented criterion together define Set as a stimulus for verifying the named Get function; preserving their conservative union avoids both unauthorized deletion of mutation coverage and an arbitrary choice. The adjacent IB Set row and OOB counterparts remain separate identities rather than resolving this row by substitution.
disposition_reason: Do not rewrite the Master or choose one conflicting fragment. Treat 2Fh Get as the named function under test and 2Eh Set as the source-required controlled stimulus. On one dedicated configurable noncritical sensor, run separately authorized IB and OOB set/get/restore subtransactions from the same proven original pair, use both paths for readback, and require exact restoration and monitoring coherence. This preserves every source command and criterion while keeping the Master contradiction visible as Source Conflict. The dedicated Set Sensor Type rows and OOB Get row keep independent coverage; evidence from this case is not cross-credited.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1107-1112, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, tests_gpt_merged, manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code occurs once in tests.json. Formal queue sequence 79 was independently verified from queue, manifest and XLSX as row 1185 / variant 009288d6d9cc9d42.

The Master title is Get Sensor Type (IB), but its explicit procedure contains Get 04h/2Fh, Set 04h/2Eh and Get 04h/2Fh over both IB and OOB; its criterion requires the sensor type to be set correctly. A Get-only rewrite would silently remove real source coverage.

The safest non-lossy interpretation is a getter round-trip: establish an original type pair, apply one approved alternate pair as controlled stimulus, and prove Get returns the change and subsequent restoration. This honors the named Get objective and every source mutation without declaring the Master text corrected.

IPMI v2.0 section 35.15 defines Set Sensor Type request bytes as sensor number, Sensor Type and Event/Reading Type with bit 7 reserved. Section 35.16 defines Get Sensor Type for one sensor and returns exactly Sensor Type plus Event/Reading Type; Get is mandatory for a sensor that implements Set.

The specification permits Set assignments to be volatile or non-volatile and explains that an initialization agent may assign a type. Therefore the case must bind a verified configurable sensor, record persistence authority and restore the exact original pair; it cannot guess from display labels or test a live thermal/control sensor.

Sensor number FFh is reserved. The Event/Reading Type reserved bit must be zero, both codes must come from standard tables or approved OEM authority, and the pair must be compatible with the selected generic/configurable sensor and downstream decoder.

IB and OOB commands in the source are preserved as two independent subtransactions, each starting and ending at the exact original pair. Using the same alternate pair makes cross-path results comparable while restoring between phases prevents an idempotent second write from masquerading as transport coverage.

Functionality row 1109 / variant a542c8677ffe2bcf separately owns Set Sensor Type (IB); rows 1236 and 1237 / variants f71ce83bd781212e and 463db30966ca0255 own OOB Set and OOB Get identities. ED-21/ED-26-style duplicate preservation means none is merged, deleted or marked covered by this integrated row.

The DeepSeek generic sensor-info command is not equivalent to exact selected-sensor 2Fh, does not exercise 2Eh, and uses command-line secrets with disabled host verification. It is rejected in favor of exact raw, secret-safe, host-verified requests.

The original Source Conflict remains because Review guidance cannot permanently repair the Get/Set and IB/OOB Master mismatch. Pending can still be removed because a conservative union has a complete safe procedure, oracle and recovery; a project choosing Get-only must report the omitted source mutation as uncovered coverage.

ED-02 preserves Source Key/variant; ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM codes; ED-13 allows a standard BMC draft with target parameters gated; ED-15 prohibits success-only PASS; ED-17 preserves logs; ED-19 and ED-21/ED-26 retain transport/duplicate identities; ED-24 preserves the source contradiction; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery and approval; ED-33 keeps Master immutable; ED-34 permits bounded Project bindings; ED-38 reserves the DUT verdict and prohibits retry.

test_case.test_name: Get Sensor Type (IB identity) using separate IB/OOB Set-Get-Restore stimulus transactions
test_case.purpose: Verify that exact Get Sensor Type 04h/2Fh reports one configurable sensor's Sensor Type and Event/Reading Type before, during and after a controlled assignment, while retaining the source's IB and OOB mutation/readback commands as separate reversible phases and preserving distinct neighboring testcase identities.
required_package: Dedicated non-production BMC/firmware with one documented configurable, noncritical sensor S (not FFh), matched SDR/controller identity and proof that 04h/2Eh is supported for that sensor

Authoritative original pair ORIG=(Sensor Type, Event/Reading Type), approved compatible alternate pair TEST different in at least one field, standard Table 42-2/42-3 or OEM/IANA definitions and bit-7/reserved validation
Documented volatile/non-volatile persistence and Initialization Agent interaction, exact ORIG restore payload, independent recovery owner and maintenance window
Pinned ipmitool/raw runner for local open IB and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus OOB, with exact completion/length parsing, per-phase no-retry state machine and redacted transcripts
Pre/post SDR, 2Fh, 2Dh reading/status, event-decoder/monitoring and preserved SEL/BMC/OS evidence plus separate immediate confirmation for each TEST assignment and its authorized restore
test_case.test_command: CONTROLLED SENSOR-TYPE MUTATION; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant, BMC/firmware and dedicated configurable sensor S; reject FFh, live protection/control sensors and unapproved OEM codes. Preserve logs and capture matched SDR, 04h/2Fh ORIG over -I open and secret-safe host-verified LANPlus, plus 2Dh/monitoring baseline; require both paths return the same exact two-byte pair and document persistence. Validate TEST=(T,E), E bit7=0, TEST compatible and different from ORIG. Phase IB: display S/ORIG/TEST/effects/recovery, obtain immediate confirmation, send once over -I open: ipmitool raw 0x04 0x2e S T E; do not retry. Require completion 00h, then send one 0x04/0x2f S over IB and one over OOB, requiring both TEST; check bounded 2Dh/event-decoder behavior. Send the preauthorized IB restore 0x04/0x2e S ORIG_T ORIG_E once and require both-path 2Fh plus monitoring return to baseline. Only after exact restoration, Phase OOB repeats the same TEST transaction via secret-safe host-verified LANPlus, verifies 2Fh over both paths, and restores ORIG via OOB once. Final evidence must show ORIG over both paths and baseline monitoring. Do not clear logs, run Initialization Agent, reset BMC, reuse evidence for rows 1109/1236/1237 or treat generic sensor info as command coverage.
test_case.expected_result: Initial IB and OOB 2Fh each return completion 00h, exactly two data bytes and identical ORIG. In each independent transport phase, the single approved 2Eh TEST write succeeds, both IB and OOB 2Fh return exactly TEST, reading/event interpretation matches the approved bounded effect, and the single same-transport restore returns both paths and monitoring to ORIG. No unrelated sensor, SDR, threshold, event-enable or log state changes. A command exit alone, generic sensor listing, one transport, idempotent second write, missing restoration or evidence cross-credit is not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires one exact dedicated settable sensor, authoritative ORIG/TEST code semantics, secure IB and OOB identity, preflight equality, separate confirmed IB and OOB TEST assignments each from ORIG, exact dual-path 2Fh TEST readback, coherent monitoring effect, one exact restore per phase and final ORIG equality with no collateral change. FAIL covers any response-length/code mismatch, unsupported or wrong sensor, TEST not observed, transports disagreeing, unexpected persistence/decoder effect, unrelated change or failed restore. NOT READY covers absent settable target, compatible alternate pair, persistence/recovery authority, secure transport, confirmation or monitoring oracle. N/A requires authoritative proof that the platform exposes no configurable sensor supporting 2Eh; read-only 2Fh evidence is partial coverage and cannot PASS the preserved combined source.
safety_gate: Use only a documented generic/configurable noncritical sensor whose type assignment cannot alter thermal, fan, power, watchdog, safety, alert-routing or production monitoring. FFh and unknown/OEM sensors without authority are prohibited.
Preserve rather than clear SDR, SEL, BMC and OS evidence. Capture ORIG independently over both transports and abort if the pair, controller/SDR identity or persistence authority differs.
Validate the coupled TEST pair against standard or owner-approved OEM definitions; Event/Reading Type bit7 must be zero. Display raw S/T/E, semantic names and exact ORIG recovery before each phase.
Each TEST write and restore is a separately planned action sent once. A timeout or uncertain completion is never retried: query 2Fh through both paths and follow the state-aware recovery tree.

Restore and prove ORIG after the IB phase before beginning OOB. Never issue the OOB TEST while the sensor is already at TEST, because that would not prove an independently effective transport mutation.

Do not reset, power-cycle, run Initialization Agent, edit SDR, thresholds or event-enable masks, or stimulate real fault events. Persistence beyond the bounded transaction is recorded from authority, not probed destructively.
Keep this row's evidence under its Source Key. The dedicated IB/OOB Set rows and OOB Get row must still be reviewed and executed under their own identities and acceptance contracts.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant, BMC/firmware, sensor/controller/SDR identity, settable/noncritical authority, persistence mode and separate related-case identities
Standard/OEM provenance for ORIG and TEST Sensor Type/Event-Reading Type codes, bit-7 validation, compatibility rationale and exact restore vector
Preserved baseline logs, matched SDR, IB/OOB raw 2Fh ORIG responses, response-length/completion parsing and reading/event-decoder baseline
For IB phase: immediate confirmation, exact one-time 2Eh request/response, dual-path 2Fh TEST, bounded monitoring evidence, exact one-time restore and dual-path ORIG
For OOB phase: separate confirmation and secret-safe transport evidence, exact one-time 2Eh, dual-path TEST, monitoring evidence, one-time restore and dual-path ORIG

Final collateral comparison for unrelated sensors/SDR/threshold/event-enable/log state, PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A, uncovered coverage statement and explicit proof that the review agent ran no DUT command
test_case.recovery: If a TEST write response is ambiguous, do not resend it; issue bounded read-only 2Fh over IB and OOB. If both show ORIG, retain the transport failure and stop the case. If both show TEST, send the already approved exact ORIG restore once through the phase's transport and verify both paths plus monitoring. If paths disagree or return any third pair, freeze mutations, preserve all logs and let the BMC owner recover through the documented controller procedure; do not reset or run Initialization Agent automatically. If a restore response is ambiguous, read 2Fh only; never repeat restore blindly. Any inability to prove ORIG and monitoring equivalence quarantines the target and is FAIL, and Phase OOB must not begin after any Phase IB anomaly.

source_conflict.reason: The immutable Master still labels the case Get/IB while its procedure and criterion require Set-then-Get over IB and OOB, and adjacent dedicated Set/OOB cases exist. The Review layer preserves this contradiction and covers the full union; it does not claim a permanent source correction.

blocked.reason: The complete conservative union has known standard commands, a selected-sensor oracle, two independent transport transactions and exact recovery. Target sensor, compatible code pair, persistence and secure endpoints are bounded Project inputs, not unresolved core semantics.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact BMC/firmware; dedicated configurable noncritical sensor and matched SDR; authoritative ORIG/TEST pair and OEM/IANA definitions if any; persistence/Initialization Agent behavior; secure IB/OOB endpoints; bounded monitoring oracle; maintenance approval and independent recovery owner.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 35.15-35.16 and Tables 35-16/35-17 define Set/Get Sensor Type, request/response bytes, reserved sensor/bit rules, mandatory Get for Set-capable sensors and volatile/non-volatile assignment/Initialization Agent context; Tables 42-2/42-3 define code spaces.

project_authority: The BMC/monitoring owner selects one genuinely settable noncritical sensor, approves the coupled alternate type pair and downstream interpretation, defines persistence and exact original-pair recovery, supplies secure transport and confirms each mutation. The owner cannot waive preserved dual-transport source coverage, exact 2Fh evidence, restoration, no-retry, distinct Source Keys or the retained Master Source Conflict.
